title: Combined exposure with microplastics increases the toxic effects of PFOS and its alternative F-53B in adult zebrafish
authors: Minfei Jian; Xi Chen; Shuai Liu; Yingxin Liu; Yu Liu; Qiyu Wang; Wenqing Tu
status: included; metadata and complete abstract checked on PubMed; programmatic verification pending
exposure: 10 μg/L PFOS or F-53B; 50 μg/L MPs; individual and combined treatments. Polymer and size not extracted from abstract.
endpoints: Freely dissolved PFAS; liver/gut accumulation; oxidative stress; immune/energy indicators; gut 16S rRNA
findings: MPs降低水中游离PFAS而未改变肝/肠累积。PFOS+MPs对肝氧化应激、免疫炎症及能量代谢影响最大；F-53B+MPs对菌群影响最大。作者将增强毒性与菌群失调关联，未将相关性写作确定因果。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). Formal interaction model, replication, polymer/size and causal microbiome experiments require full text.
locator: PubMed PMID38365036, Abstract; citation 2024 Apr 10;920:170948, online 2024-02-15.

title: Sorption of PFOS onto polystyrene microplastics potentiates synergistic toxic effects during zebrafish embryogenesis and neurodevelopment
authors: Priya Gupta; Archisman Mahapatra; Bharat Manna; Anjali Suman; Shubhendu Shekhar Ray; Naresh Singhal; Rahul Kumar Singh
status: included; metadata and complete abstract checked on PubMed; programmatic verification pending
exposure: PFOS with PS-MPs; several sorption concentrations; exact biological exposure doses/particle diameter not extracted from abstract.
endpoints: Molecular dynamics; SEM/fluorescence chorion localization; hatching; death/malformations; heartbeat; ROS/antioxidants; AChE/neurotransmitters; behavior
findings: PS-MPs与PFOS可相互作用并在卵膜累积。共同暴露加重孵化延迟、死亡及畸形，伴随氧化状态、AChE、神经递质和行为变化。作者称协同毒性；该标签在本记录中按作者原意保留，尚未核对其数学判据。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). Formal synergy criterion and exact exposure design require full text.
locator: PubMed PMID39368493, Abstract lines245–249; citation Chemosphere366:143462, online2024-10-03.

title: Developmental stage-dependent carrier effects of nanoplastics on PFOS bioaccumulation and toxicity in zebrafish: Insights from toxicokinetic-toxicodynamic perspective
authors: Jiayu Ma; Ning Gao; Xiang Yuan; Lanpeng Yang; Lin Zhu; Jianfeng Feng
status: included; PubMed citation year2026, online2025-09-22; complete abstract checked; programmatic verification pending
exposure: Nanoplastics+PFOS versus PFOS; exact concentrations and particle details not extracted from abstract.
duration: Stage windows0–48h and72–168h as reported in abstract; not assumed to be a single continuous exposure.
endpoints: PFOS uptake/accumulation; hatching; oxidative/metabolic/neural pathways; behavior; TK modeling; internal-concentration BBMD
findings: 胚胎期NP减少PFOS累积并缓解孵化抑制；仔鱼期则增加累积并加重氧化、代谢、通路及行为效应。内部浓度BBMD未显示NP显著改变PFOS剂量反应关系，作者将阶段差异主要解释为TK载体效应。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). Model specification, exposure controls and dose estimates require full text.
locator: PubMed PMID41005273, Abstract lines237–241; Water Research288(PtA):124658, issue2026-01-01, online2025-09-22. PubMed spells third author Xiang Yuan.

title: Proteomic and metabolic responses in zebrafish embryos exposed to polystyrene nanoparticles and perfluorooctane sulfonate
authors: Jixiang Gong; Xuri Wu; Xin He; Feng Tan
status: included; publisher complete abstract/citation returned through web search; direct landing/full-text requests403; programmatic verification pending
stage: exposure starting48hpf; authors call embryos, extends into larval development
endpoints: Deformities; embryolethality; proteomics; metabolomics; cardiac contraction-related proteins
findings: 共暴露随时间出现作者所称加和/协同胚胎致死效应。单PSNP、单PFOS及共暴露组分别有439、421、692个差异蛋白，涉及蛋白合成运输、能量代谢及心肌收缩；代谢物变化涉及多类基础代谢。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). Protein counts are not effect sizes or proof of mechanistic causation; interaction calculation requires full text.
locator: RSC publisher Abstract and Article information; Environmental Science: Nano12:4042–4055; first published2025-07-01.

title: Combined toxicity of polyethylene micro/nanoplastics and PFOA in zebrafish (Danio rerio): Impacts on antioxidant, neurotransmission, and gut microbiota
authors: Xia Wang; Ruixuan Li; Bo Cheng; Yingxue Sun; Xiaolong Yao; Chun Wang
status: included; PubMed complete abstract and publisher metadata checked; issue2026Jan, online2025-12-19; programmatic verification pending
exposure: PE-MPs, PE-NPs and PFOA alone/mixtures; exact doses/size not extracted from abstract.
duration: Chronic; exact length not extracted from abstract.
endpoints: Gill/liver/gut antioxidant and LPO/GSH markers; AChE; IBRv2; microbiota and predicted pathways
findings: 作者依据IBRv2将共同毒性描述为鳃/肝协同而肠道拮抗。PFOA降低菌群丰富度/多样性，塑料存在时这些指标增加；各组合的推断微生物代谢通路亦不同。记录为器官特异性指标结果。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). IBRv2-based interaction labels should not be equated with independent concentration-addition tests without full methods.
locator: PubMed PMID41422984 Abstract and citation; Environmental Toxicology and Pharmacology121:104907; publisher Introduction identifies adults.

title: Co-exposure of polyethylene terephthalate micro- and nanoplastics with per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances triggers immune dysregulation, apoptotic activation, and neurotoxicity
authors: Santhanam Sanjai Dharshan; S Madesh; Shreya Madhankumar Rao; Karthikeyan Ramamurthy; Rajakrishnan Rajagopal; Ahmed Alfarhan; Ki Choon Choi; Jesu Arockiaraj
status: included; PubMed complete abstract/citation checked; programmatic verification pending
exposure: PET-MNPs250 μg/L or2.5 mg/L; PFOA20 μg/L or200 μg/L. Particle size not extracted from abstract.
endpoints: Particle distribution; ROS/LPO; apoptosis/immune stains; AChE/neurobehavior; lipid/hematological stains; gene expression
findings: 共暴露产生消化道/肝/胰粒子累积、氧化应激、免疫细胞浸润、凋亡及低活动等表现。转录标记涉及炎症、凋亡、抗氧化和神经功能；作者使用加和毒性表述，未在本记录升格为协同证据。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). PFOA-carrier explanation and environmentally relevant concentration designation are author interpretations; measured internal PFOA and interaction model require full text.

title: Polystyrene modulation of perfluorooctanoic acid toxicity in zebrafish: Transcriptomic and toxicological insights
authors: Yuanyuan Zhao; Siyi Zhang; Yu Liu; Shiguo Li; Jing Hou
status: included; complete PubMed abstract plus publisher Test chemicals/Acute toxicity/Conclusion/SI snippets checked; programmatic verification pending
stage: Not extracted from accessed abstract/section snippets.
exposure: PFOA with0.2,2,20 μm non-functionalized PS particles; acute PFOA series. Single PFOA96hLC50=72.64 mg/L (publisher result snippet).
duration: 96h acute test; other assay schedules not extracted.
endpoints: Survival; internal PFOA; gut/muscle histopathology; transcriptomics; molecular dynamics
findings: PS影响随粒径和端点改变；2及20 μm粒子进一步降低存活并增加PFOA累积。转录结果分别涉及神经递质、氨基酸代谢和II相结合途径，组织损害在高PFOA条件更明显。
limitations: Method weakness checklist not completed; only named abstract/result/material snippets read. Reader-inferred applicability limit: high-dose acute mortality does not by itself establish effects at field concentrations; this is an untested external-validity inference, not a claimed design defect.
locator: PubMed PMID41027221 Abstract; ScienceDirect PII S0304389425028705 sections Test chemicals, Acute toxicity of PFOA to zebrafish with and without PS, Conclusion, Supporting information; J Hazard Mater498:139951, online2025-09-25.

title: Co-exposure to polystyrene microplastics and perfluorooctanoic acid can exacerbate lipid metabolism disorders and liver damage in adult zebrafish
authors: Sijie Tian; Ruixiang Li; Ya Zeng; Lingfeng Qin; Caicheng Long; Taiping Qing; Peng Zhang; Bo Feng
status: included; PubMed citation/complete abstract checked; issue2026May, online2025-10-10; programmatic verification pending
exposure: PS-MPs and PFOA, individual and combined; exact doses and particle size not extracted from abstract.
endpoints: Gut/liver histology; oxidative/lipid markers; blood LPS; microbiota; transcriptomics
findings: 共暴露比各单暴露的肠/肝损伤更重，伴随菌群失衡和脂代谢基因/通路变化；作者将屏障损伤、血LPS与肝脂质紊乱联系。摘要未给正式协同模型，不把更强效应自动称为协同。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). Causal gut-liver pathway and interaction statistics require full text.
